{{Quote|It's all a big joke to you, right?|Bric, to Cutup|<ref name="rookies" />}}
'''Cutup''', also known by the number '''CT-4040''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a rookie [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] or "[[Shiny/Legends|shinie]]," he was stationed at the [[Rishi moon]] [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening station]], an outpost to warn the Republic of an [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]], Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] infiltrated the station and killed [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]] sent troopers [[Nub/Legends|Nub]] and [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]] to look for 327, however, both were taken by surprise and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. CT-19-7409 ordered the other four [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers to signal the [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]] before the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] killed him, although the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the signal. Cutup, along with fellow troopers [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] and [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] escaped through a ventilation shaft. After coming out the shaft, which led them outside the station, Cutup was attacked and eaten by a [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]].

==Biography==
===Training on Kamino===
{{Quote|You're a real cutup, aren't you?!|Bric giving CT-4040 his name|<ref name="cc" />}}
[[File:CutupFivesBunks-CC.png|thumb|left|220px|Cutup and Fives in the [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> CT-4040 was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> He along with the rest of [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino squad]] underwent training on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] where he and squad were doing very poorly. 4040 did not seem to take the tests very seriously, joking around and making disparaging comments about his [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] efficiency. Despite his light-hearted manner, he did show concern for his brothers, shown in the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]] test in which [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]] was shot and injured, as he was the only one in the squad to stop and check up on his wounded comrade. He soon abandoned Droidbait under the duress of his other squadmates, which led to the failure of the test.<ref name="cc" />

Later, [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] asked for 4040 in the hangar bay, believing the clone to be the reason why his squad was failing, 4040 once more showed his lack of solemnity, going as far to mock and insult his trainer, causing Bric to physically assault the trooper and and scorn him for his jesting nature, unintentionally dubbing him "Cutup" in the process. After this incident, he was able to work with his squad in the final test, warning his comrade [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] of flanking droid fire and pushing forward with the others with effective teamwork. Domino Squad passed and they all graduated and shipped out to fight the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]].<ref name="cc" />

===The Rishi Station===
{{Quote|You wanted excitement, Hevy.''"<br />"''Right. Ooooh, meteor shower.|Cutup and Hevy, with the latter being sarcastic|audio=YouWantedExcitement-Rookies.flac|<ref name="rookies" />}}
The escalating war demanded more clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and many younger clones - including Cutup - were pushed into service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Cutup was stationed on a [[Rishi Station/Legends|remote]] [[Listening post/Legends|Listening post]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rishi moon|of]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], which was supposed to warn the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in case of a Separatist attack.<ref name="rookies" />

[[File:Cutup2.png|thumb|right|220px|Cutup's last moments]]
While Cutup, along with fellow troopers [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], Fives, [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Nub/Legends|Nub]] and Droidbait were inside the station, clone trooper [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]] was outside guarding the base. Inside the base, while Cutup was arm wrestling with Hevy and lost, the clones entered a brief conservation with Echo and [[Fives]] about the boring work at the station. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]] appeared and informed them that some officers will come on an inspection. Soon, their [[Sensor/Legends|long range sensors]] detected an incoming [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]].<ref name="rookies" />

The clones raised the defensive shields, which blocked any meteors that land too close, although several struck in the crater plains outside. After a while O'Niner didn't receive any contact from CT-327 and sent Nub and Droidbait to search for him. Both troopers were taken by surprise as Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], after they sliced the door open and [[Death/Legends|killed]] both clones with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots. The other clone troopers recognized the attack and O'Niner began fighting the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The clone [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] ordered the other four troopers to signal the fleet that they are being attacked, but the droids [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the signal.<ref name="rookies" />

O'Niner was quickly slain by the fire of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and Cutup, Hevy, Echo and Fives escaped through a ventilation shaft before the door was cut open. After leaving the shaft outside the station, the clones conferred about what to do. Then, a [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]] appeared behind Cutup, dragged him away and killed him. The three surviving clone troopers were able to retake the station with help of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] who had arrived to inspect the outpost.<ref name="rookies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Aw, leave him alone. They kept him in his growth jar too long.|Cutup teasing Echo|audio=GrowthJarTooLong-Rookies.flac|<ref name="rookies" />}}
[[File:Cutup-TCW.png|thumb|right|135px|Cutup was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic.]]
As a clone cadet, Cutup showed qualities of being the clown of Domino Squad, telling jokes, teasing his fellow cadets, making light-hearted comments about other cadet squads, and mocking his trainer, Bric. Nevertheless, Cutup cared greatly for his fellow cadets, stopping to check on a wounded Droidbait when the clone was shot from behind.<ref name="cc" />

After being shipped out to the Rishi Moon, Cutup, like most of the other clones there, was an inexperienced rookie trooper and he was bored with working at the station. He challenged Hevy a lot, but they got along well, participating in idle entertainment like arm wrestling. He would also join Hevy in teasing Echo, because the trooper was focused on protocols and manuals. Cutup sported a goatee while he served on the Rishi Moon, perhaps embracing his own individuality like many of the other clones during the Clone Wars.<ref name="rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Cutup" first appeared in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the Clone Wars TV series]], aired at [[October 24]] [[2008]]. He also appeared in the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], titled "[[Clone Cadets]]," which chronologically took place before "Rookies." In the episodes, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers through the series.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref>
